answer: Require each agent identity to stake a refundable deposit that is slashed on proven fraud, like a pigment that marks every thread of work it touches. New identities start in a shallow lagoon: low trust, capped transaction size, and rate-limited calls until they accumulate verified, attested history. A Sybil attacker must then fund and age thousands of deposits, so creating fake identities costs real capital and time instead of being free.
